title: Plaint for money recovery (Order VII CPC)

entries.averment: The cause of action is pleaded with both its date and its place.
Pecuniary jurisdiction is pleaded: the suit value is within the forum's ceiling.
Territorial jurisdiction is pleaded on at least one s.20 CPC basis (defendant resides / carries on business, or cause of action arose here).
The suit is within limitation; where relied upon, a written acknowledgement restarting the period is pleaded.
The account statement reconciles: principal plus interest equals the total claimed.
Against a Government/public officer defendant, a notice under s.80 CPC is pleaded.
In a commercial suit, a s.12A pre-institution mediation certificate or a pleaded exemption is present, with a statement of truth.

source.ref: s.12A Commercial Courts Act 2015; Patil Automation v. Rakheja Engineers

entries.averment: The court fee and the valuation basis are both pleaded.

source.ref: TN Court Fees and Suits Valuation Act 1955

entries.averment: Where contractual interest is claimed without a supporting document, interest falls back to the statutory rate and the plaint says so.
